# MOT failure notes

The Astra's 2024 MOT. First proper fail since I've had the car. Writing down everything because it's the paper trail I'll want when selling.

## The test

- Date: 14 March 2024
- Station: Kingswood MOT Centre, Regent Street. Tester: Bev Hollins
- Mileage: 111,742
- Test number: 4471 2290 8813
- Result: FAIL, 2 major, 4 advisories

## Majors

1. **Nearside front coil spring fractured** (5.3.1 (b) (i)). Bottom coil snapped right at the seat, you could see it with the wheel turned. Never noticed a thing driving it, maybe a bit of a clunk over speed bumps
2. **Offside rear brake light not working** (4.1.1 (a) (ii)). Bulb. Embarrassing for an electrician

## Advisories

- Nearside front tyre worn close to legal limit (2.1mm)
- Front brake pads wearing thin (yeah, see [[Brake pad wear]], got done in October)
- Oil leak, but not excessive. Rocker cover gasket weeping onto the exhaust manifold heat shield
- Rear subframe corroded but not seriously affecting its structural integrity

## The fixes

### Coil spring

- Kingswood quoted £185 for one spring fitted. Springs should be done in pairs, so asked for both fronts: £290
- Phoned Stavros at Fishponds Autos instead: £210 for both fronts, Lesjöfors springs, plus a wheel alignment check
- Did it Friday 15 March. Old spring had a 4cm piece missing at the end

### Brake light

- Bulb was a P21/5W twin filament in the rear cluster. £2.50 for 2 at Halfords
- Actual fault was a corroded bulb holder contact, not just the bulb. Cleaned it with a fibreglass pen and a dab of dielectric grease. Works

### Tyre

- Two new fronts, Michelin Primacy 4 205/55 R16, £178 fitted at Hartcliffe Tyre Co (same lot who did [[Winter tyres]])

## Retest

- Monday 18 March 2024, same station, Bev again
- Partial retest within 10 working days = free
- Invoice KMC-50613, £0.00 retest, original test £54.85
- PASS. Advisories carried over: oil leak, subframe corrosion

## Costs for this round

| Item | Cost |
|---|---|
| MOT | £54.85 |
| Springs (Fishponds Autos) | £210 |
| Front tyres | £178 |
| Brake light bulbs | £2.50 |
| **Total** | **£445.35** |

## 2025 MOT

- 12 March 2025, 119,580 miles, Kingswood again, tester Ross this time
- PASS first time, advisories: subframe corrosion (same), rocker cover still weeping, nearside rear tyre 3.1mm
- Did the rocker cover gasket myself after: £19 gasket, 8 bolts at 8 Nm, no more burning oil smell at junctions

## Takeaways

- Do a walkround a week before: every bulb, horn, wipers, washers, tyres, look at the springs with a torch
- Keep this note and all the receipts. Buyers liked seeing it, see [[Selling the old hatchback]]
- Check the MOT history on the gov site before buying any used car. Did it for the MG, see [[Car loan]]
